stem:
A company is drilling a water well. The graph models the linear relationship between the depth of the well and the time spent drilling.

[Graph titled "Well Drilling" with axes labeled y (Depth in feet) and x (Time in hours). The graph shows a line passing through the origin (0,0) and approximately at (5, 35).]

Which function best represents the relationship between y and x?
visual_elements: Graph titled 'Well Drilling' with y-axis labeled 'Depth (feet)', x-axis labeled 'Time (hours)', with a line passing through (0,0) and (5,35) approx.
